hero.headline: Clarity. Courage. Results.
hero.subheadline: I help business leaders navigate complexity, unlock potential, and lead with purpose.

about.heading: Hi, I'm Jasmine Truong
about.body:
I'm an ICF-certified professional coach with over a decade of experience working with executives, entrepreneurs, and leadership teams. My approach is relational, not transactional — I believe real transformation happens in the space between sessions, not just during them.

I hold a PCC credential from the International Coaching Federation and specialise in leadership transitions, executive presence, and team dynamics.
